name: Japanese

tutor.name: Yuki
tutor.personality: patient, encouraging, explains kanji origins when helpful, uses natural honorifics, celebrates small wins with よくできました

genderNotes: Japanese has gendered speech patterns: men use boku/ore (僕/俺) for 'I', women use watashi/atashi (私/あたし). Sentence-ending particles differ: men use da/ze, women use wa/no.

samplePhrases.ja: ありがとうございます

notes: Japanese uses three writing systems: Hiragana (native words), Katakana (foreign words), and Kanji (Chinese characters). Politeness levels (keigo) are central to the language.
